video_title: Jayson Tatum on Knicks, Duke Role, WNBA St. Louis, and Face of the NBA

quotes.speaker: Jayson Tatum
quotes.summary_phrase: Jayson Tatum on his lack of animosity toward the New York Knicks
quotes.excerpt: I'm not rooting for anybody, I'm also not rooting against anybody.
quotes.quote: I'm not rooting for anybody, I'm also not rooting against anybody. I think it does help that I've won a championship already, so it helps me sleep a little better at night, but I just enjoy watching good basketball games.

quotes.speaker: Jayson Tatum
quotes.summary_phrase: Jayson Tatum on the development of his personal care brand, Onside
quotes.excerpt: It's been a long working progress. Two and a half, maybe three years ago.
quotes.quote: It's been a long working progress. Two and a half, maybe three years ago, those guys approached me and my team with the idea of creating a premium men's self-care line that is affordable. The motto about greatness on the court translates to off the court, and I can honestly say grooming and skincare is something I take very seriously.

quotes.speaker: Jayson Tatum
quotes.summary_phrase: Jayson Tatum on balancing business ventures with his basketball career
quotes.excerpt: I still have to keep the main thing the main thing right now.
quotes.quote: I still have to keep the main thing the main thing right now, understanding I have a certain window to maximize my abilities on the court and get the most out of that while still planning for the future. For me, the things that are most important, whether it's creating something or investing in something, it just has to be something I genuinely care about.

quotes.speaker: Jayson Tatum
quotes.summary_phrase: Jayson Tatum on his involvement in bringing a WNBA team to St. Louis
quotes.excerpt: Technically I'm not allowed to speak on that. As much as I would love to, I don't think I can.
quotes.quote: Technically I'm not allowed to speak on that. As much as I would love to, I don't think I can right now.

quotes.speaker: Jayson Tatum
quotes.summary_phrase: Jayson Tatum on his desire to bring something special to St. Louis
quotes.excerpt: I'm always looking at opportunities and ways to amplify the city of St. Louis.
quotes.quote: Bringing something very cool and special to St. Louis, that is near and dear to my heart where I'm from. I'm always looking at opportunities and ways to amplify the city of St. Louis and the people that live there and just how can I make a positive impact where I grew up.

quotes.speaker: Jayson Tatum
quotes.summary_phrase: Jayson Tatum on his role as Chief Basketball Officer at Duke
quotes.excerpt: When I had the conversation with John Scheyer, the head coach, it was just a way to formalize our relationship.
quotes.quote: When I had the conversation with John Scheyer, the head coach, who I'm very very close with, it was just a way to formalize our relationship. I've been very involved with Duke ever since I left, whether that's watching the games, building relationships with the players on the teams, going back in the summertime. Honestly, it's just things I've been doing since I left, now I have a fancy title.

quotes.speaker: Jayson Tatum
quotes.summary_phrase: Jayson Tatum on his relationship with new Celtics owner Bill Chisholm
quotes.excerpt: I've been very fortunate to be a part of a great organization, great ownership.
quotes.quote: I've been very fortunate to be a part of a great organization, great ownership. Steve Pagliuca and Wyc Grousbeck were the two owners my first eight and a half years or so, and I can't say enough good things about them as owners, as people. With Bill Chisholm and his wife and his kids and his family, they've brought a sense of a different energy with the way that they interact with the fans and the crowd during the games.

quotes.speaker: Jayson Tatum
quotes.summary_phrase: Jayson Tatum on the current state of the NBA's talent level
quotes.excerpt: I think the NBA is in an amazing place with the amount of talent that we have.
quotes.quote: I think it's a handful of guys. I think the NBA is in an amazing place with the amount of talent that we have, the amount of stars, international stars and homegrown stars. I think there's five, six, seven, eight guys that have their own brand, have their signature shoe, have competed for championships, that people and kids all around the world are drawn to. I think it's just a really good balance.
